Field data

Upload the latest export from the Izon app. The follow-up list rebuilds from it — priorities are set automatically and any progress already logged is kept for lines that still appear.

SKUs
Upload the complete ZIP exactly as it comes out of Izon. All five issue sheets are imported — No Sales, Out of Stock, Article Status Changes, Discontinued Stock and Negative Stock — plus slow movers from Site Day Cover, and the Range-gap & ROS analysis is rebuilt. Every sheet is verified against the file's own record totals before anything is saved; if a single row can't be accounted for, nothing is imported.
Accepts .xlsx or .csv. The file needs columns for store, SOH, days since last sold and article — extra columns (banner, region, barcode, dates) are picked up automatically.

Pricing

Upload a price list — item code and price (banner optional). The system matches it to the report by item code and estimates the value of stock not moving. Re-upload any time to refresh.

Needs at least an item-code column and a price column. If a Banner column is present, banner-specific prices are used where available. Extra columns are ignored.

Products in report

Mark a product as seasonal or temporarily discontinued and its lines drop out of the report everywhere — across all stores and future uploads — until you switch it back to active.

GitHub / history archive

Every upload is archived so the system builds history over time. Download the archive and commit it to your repo so every device loads the same complete record.

Put continental_brands_field_followup.html in your repo (root or /docs) and the archive at /data/history.json. When served from GitHub Pages the app loads ./data/history.json automatically, so committing the updated file keeps the complete folder in sync for everyone.

Export follow-up

Pull the current tracker for management — status, root cause, feedback, rep, escalation and who closed each gap.
